occurrences.en: Here we were obliged to come to an anchor, and here we lay, the wind continuing contrary—viz. at south-west—for seven or eight days, during which time a great many ships from Newca
occurrences.cn: 在这里我们只得下锚停泊，就这么停着，风仍旧是逆的——就是西南风——一连刮了七八天；这期间，许多从纽卡斯尔来的船也驶进了这同一片锚地，把它当作寻常的避风港，好在这儿等一阵顺风驶进河去

occurrences.en: Towards evening the mate and boatswain begged the master of our ship to let them cut away the fore-mast, which he was very unwilling to do; but the boatswain protesting to him that
occurrences.cn: 傍晚时分，大副和水手长恳求船长准许他们砍掉前桅，船长很不情愿；可水手长向他力陈，若不砍船就要沉，船长这才应了；等他们砍掉前桅，主桅便晃荡得松脱脱的，把船摇得那么厉害，他们只得连它也

occurrences.en: While this was doing, the master, seeing some light colliers, who, not able to ride out the storm were obliged to slip and run away to sea, and would come near us, ordered to fire
occurrences.cn: 正干着，船长瞧见几条运煤的轻船——它们经不住这场风暴，只得砍缆放漂、逃往大海，眼看要漂近我们——便下令放一炮，作为求救的信号。

occurrences.en: However, to cut short this melancholy part of our story, our ship being disabled, and three of our men killed, and eight wounded, we were obliged to yield, and were carried all pri
occurrences.cn: 然而,长话短说,把我们这段惨痛的经历说完吧:我们的船已丧失战力,死了三人,伤了八人,只得投降,全被押作俘虏带进萨累——那是摩尔人的一个港口。

candidates.global_gloss_en: It means to want to say something.

occurrences.cn: 他说，我只凭这一件事便可以掂量出这种境地有多幸福——就是说，这正是别人个个羡慕的境地；帝王们常常悲叹自己生来担着大事业的苦命，恨不能生在两个极端之间、居于卑贱与显赫之间；就连那位智

occurrences.en: He bade me observe it, and I should always find that the calamities of life were shared among the upper and lower part of mankind, but that the middle station had the fewest disast
occurrences.cn: 他嘱咐我留意，我便会明白：人生的种种灾祸，多半落在上层和下层人身上，唯独中间境地的人遭的祸患最少，不像上层或下层的人那样饱经无常的起落；不仅如此，他们也不像那些人——一边是靠着放荡

occurrences.en: Neither was this all; for my goods being all English manufacture, such as cloths, stuffs, baize, and things particularly valuable and desirable in the country, I found means to sel
occurrences.cn: 还不止这些呢;因为我的货全是英国货,像呢绒、料子、粗呢这类在当地格外值钱、格外抢手的东西,我便设法把它们卖了个大价钱;所以可以说,我如今赚得的价值比头一批货高出四倍还多,已远远超过

occurrences.en: I confess I had not entertained any notion of my ammunition being destroyed at one blast—I mean my powder being blown up by lightning; and this made the thoughts of it so surprisin
occurrences.cn: 我承认,我从没想过我的弹药会被一下子炸毁——我是说我的火药会被雷电引爆;正因如此,如我方才所说,当电闪雷鸣时,这个念头才叫我那样吃惊。

occurrences.en: During these first hurries I was stupid, lying still in my cabin, which was in the steerage, and cannot describe my temper: I could ill resume the first penitence which I had so ap
occurrences.cn: 在这最初的一阵慌乱里，我木呆呆的，一动不动地躺在我那间设在舵舱的小舱里，那份心境实在没法描摹：我早已明摆着把当初那点悔悟践踏了、又硬着心肠抵挡它，如今再难拾起；我原以为死亡的苦楚已

occurrences.en: As to going home, shame opposed the best motions that offered to my thoughts, and it immediately occurred to me how I should be laughed at among the neighbours, and should be asham
occurrences.cn: 说到回家，羞耻压住了我脑子里冒出来的一切好念头；我立时想到街坊邻里会怎样笑话我，我会羞于去见——不单是父亲母亲，连别的什么人都羞于去见；由此我后来常常留意到，人的常情、尤其是年轻人

occurrences.en: It would make the reader pity me, or rather laugh at me, to tell how many awkward ways I took to raise this paste; what odd, misshapen, ugly things I made; how many of them fell in
occurrences.cn: 要说我用了多少笨拙的法子来和这团泥;做出多少稀奇古怪、歪歪扭扭、丑陋不堪的东西;有多少塌了进去、又有多少瘫了下来,因为泥不够硬,撑不住自己的分量;有多少因为晒得太急,被烈日烤裂了;

occurrences.en: Then I reproached myself with my unthankful temper, and that I had repined at my solitary condition; and now what would I give to be on shore there again!
occurrences.cn: 接着我又责备起自己那副不知感恩的性子,怪自己从前竟对孤零零的处境满腹牢骚;如今我情愿拿什么去换,只求能再回到那岸上啊!

occurrences.en: I embraced the offer; and entering into a strict friendship with this captain, who was an honest, plain-dealing man, I went the voyage with him, and carried a small adventure with
occurrences.cn: 我欣然接受了这个提议;和这位船长结成了亲密的友谊——他是个诚实、正直的人——就随他出了海,还带了一小笔本钱做买卖,靠着这位船长朋友的一片无私诚意,这本钱增值了许多;因为我照船长的吩

occurrences.en: The man that had the lance or dart did not fly from them, but the rest did; however, as the two creatures ran directly into the water, they did not offer to fall upon any of the ne
occurrences.cn: 拿着标枪或投枪的那个人没有逃走,其余的人都逃了;不过那两只野兽一直冲进了水里,并没有去扑那些黑人,而是纵身跳进海中,游来游去,好像是来玩耍似的;末了,其中一只开始比我起初料想的更靠

occurrences.en: I told him he had been so generous to me in everything that I could not offer to make any price of the boat, but left it entirely to him: upon which he told me he would give me a n
occurrences.cn: 我对他说,他待我样样都那么慷慨,我实在不好意思为这船开价,全由他做主;于是他说他会给我立一张字据,到了巴西付我八十枚八字银元;等船运到那儿,要是有人肯出更高的价，他还会给我补足。

occurrences.en: But I, that was born to be my own destroyer, could no more resist the offer than I could restrain my first rambling designs when my father’s good counsel was lost upon me.
occurrences.cn: 可我这个天生要毁自己的人,竟没法抵挡这提议,正如当年父亲的良言在我身上白费、我按捺不住头一回四处漂泊的念头一样。

occurrences.en: But alas! a few days wore it all off; and, in short, to prevent any of my father’s further importunities, in a few weeks after I resolved to run quite away from him.
occurrences.cn: 可是，唉！没几天工夫，这决心便烟消云散了；简单说，为了免得父亲再来啰唆，几个礼拜之后我便打定主意，索性从他身边一走了之。

occurrences.en: I walked about a furlong from the shore, to see if I could find any fresh water to drink, which I did, to my great joy; and having drank, and put a little tobacco into my mouth to
occurrences.cn: 我从岸边走出约莫一浪远,想看看能不能找到点淡水喝,还真找到了,叫我喜出望外;喝过水,又往嘴里塞了一点烟草压压饥,我便走到那棵树跟前,爬了上去,想法子把自己安顿好,免得万一睡着了会摔

occurrences.en: After I had been there about ten or twelve days, it came into my thoughts that I should lose my reckoning of time for want of books, and pen and ink, and should even forget the Sab
occurrences.cn: 我在那儿待了约莫十天或十二天后,忽然想到,由于没有书籍、没有纸笔,我会算不清日子,甚至会忘了安息日;为防止这事,我用刀在一根大柱子上刻下大写字母——并把它做成一个大十字架,竖在我最

occurrences.en: I reproached myself with my laziness, that would not sow any more corn one year than would just serve me till the next season, as if no accident could intervene to prevent my enjoy
occurrences.cn: 我责备自己懒惰，一年里种的谷子只够撑到下一季，仿佛不会有什么意外插进来、妨碍我享用地里的收成似的；我觉得这个责备实在中肯，于是下定决心，往后要预先存下两三年的谷子，这样不管出什么事

occurrences.en: To make short this sad part of my story, we went the way of all sailors; the punch was made and I was made half drunk with it: and in that one night’s wickedness I drowned all my r
occurrences.cn: 长话短说，把我这段伤心的故事说短些吧——我们走上了所有水手都走的老路：潘趣酒调好了，我被灌得半醉；就在那一夜的荒唐里，我把满腔的悔恨、把对过往行径的一切反省、把对将来的一切决心，全

occurrences.en: —Very ill; frighted almost to death with the apprehensions of my sad condition—to be sick, and no help.
occurrences.cn: 病得很重;一想到自己处境凄凉——病倒了又无人相助——几乎吓得要死。

occurrences.en: I walked about, but was very weak, and withal very sad and heavy-hearted under a sense of my miserable condition, dreading, the return of my distemper the next day.
occurrences.cn: 我走动了一阵,却十分虚弱,加上一想到自己凄惨的处境便忧愁沉重,满心恐惧第二天病又会发。

occurrences.en: I was struck dumb with these reflections, as one astonished, and had not a word to say—no, not to answer to myself, but rose up pensive and sad, walked back to my retreat, and went
occurrences.cn: 这些反省叫我哑口无言,像人惊呆了一般,一个字也说不出——不,连回答自己也答不上,只是满怀愁思悲哀地站起身,走回我的藏身处,翻过我的墙头,仿佛要去睡觉;可我思绪扰乱得厉害,一点睡意也
